en: Hmm. So there's a whole line of witches waiting to enter the garden.
I won't deny it's a lovely place to live.
But that doesn't mean they can just create their own realms without telling us.
Even witches need to have rules.
Wait!
Did I just say that? Eww, I sound just like Chloe!
If you weren't so short, I wouldn't be able to tell you two apart.
Hmph...
I'm home!
Welcome.
...What's that?
It smells like mud and moss.
Oh, this?
It was a gift, I suppose.
I was going to put it with my other scissors.
Hmm.
At least brush your shoes off before coming in.
You're making my house dirty.
I've barely been back five seconds and I'm being nagged at...
And this is my house, not yours!
If it were yours, you'd care more about its clealiness than I do.
You've forfeited your rights as a homeowner.
Okay, okay. I'll clean up now and then.
Take care not to touch my whiskers.
Why on earth would I want to touch your whiskers?
Until the other day, you wouldn't even let me pet you.
That's why you need to be more careful when you do.
My exquisite fur is a far cry from the crude fabrics you handle so clumsily.
You'd do well to keep that in mind...
You need to ban Abigail from visiting.
Huh? Why?
Every time she pets me, I feel like I'm being crushed.
Aha, I think I know what you're talking about.
It was like wringing out a black towel.
And yet you just watched me suffer.
All right, I'll tell her to stop it.
You can turn into a human.
So why do you insist on staying in cat form?
Because being a cat is true to my nature.
You can't even drink water from a cup properly.
You're always knocking them on the floor.
I knock them on the floor because I want to.
I'm not trying to drink from them.
When was the last time you saw Nahatra?
Hmph. I have no need to meet with Nahatra in person.
I don't even bother with attending those tea parties.
Oh... Come to think of it, why is that?
Because there isn't a single thing there worth eating.
That's because the tea parties aren't for you...
Besides, it's not like you usually eat much anyway.
Precisely. That's exactly my point.
You seem to get along well with those two lately.
Who? Rims and Berry?
How could I not? They're so kind and caring. They practically worship me.
Kind...? Caring...?
You could learn a thing or two from them.
I really don't think so.
We're out of dried catnip, Sil.
I would appreciate you restocking it.
You asked me to help you kick your catnip habit.
So I won't be restocking any for a while.
What...?
This is neglect! Animal abuse!
I'm only doing as you asked.
So quit complaining.
You'll regret this.
Canele, I've got some warm water.
I spend half my day cleaning myself.
So don't even dream of giving me a bath.
I know you take pride in your cleanliness.
But if you want to sleep on my bed, you'll have to bathe every now and then.
Wait! Put that down.
...I'll get in on my own.
There's a little spider on your back, Sil.
Huh? There is!?
Did it climb on when I met Chloe? Where is it...?
Gotcha!
It's kinda cute up close. Should I keep it as a pet?
I don't mind, but...
What if it's a spy for Chloe?
It might report everything it saw and heard here.
...I guess it's best to release it outside after all.
Hey, Canele. Look at this.
Cat clothes! Try it on!
Sil, I'm not questioning your sewing skills.
But why would I wear "cat clothes"?
I'm more than comfortable in this environment without clothes.
But the moment I put this on, my soul will be emptied and I'll be overcome with nihilism...
Who cares! Just try it on!
Ugh... I really don't understand you.
You know I go on my little walks sometimes...
You're quite famous among the neighborhood cats, Sil.
I am?
What do they say about me?
That's a secret.
Just how far back do you and Nahatra go?
Very very far back.
Come on, give me a proper answer.
I did.
I don't really know how long it's been.
We all know witches don't die.
Then what happens in the end? Is there even an end?
Yes, witches don't die.
They just meet their end.
Hmph...
Nightmares and the garden are like two sides of the same coin.
Be careful not to bend that coin, Sil.
What does that even mean?
You've been hanging out in Chloe's realm a lot lately.
Since when were you two so close?
We're not "hanging out". Our relationship is strictly business.
We both have a promise we need to keep, so we have a relationship based on trust.
Business...?
She pays me to translate books written in cat language.
Here, you can read our contract, if you like. There's nothing untoward in there.
Contract...? This thick tome is a contract...?
The adult world is a complicated place, Sil.
Fiena's concoction tastes lighter than I expected.
Huh? You've tried it?!
So what? You have too.
No, I haven't.
I guess you don't remember.
Did you climb onto my face again while I was sleeping?
Did you notice?
Why are you only like that when I'm sleeping? You usually try to avoid touching me at all.
I probably shouldn't mention you once died of suffocation in the middle of the night.
What?!
Kidding.
What would you like for dinner?
Ham and grilled cheese. A glass of wine would be nice too.
Again? And we have no wine.
Another day of disappointment.
The only disappointment here is your eating habits.
You're so picky, even for a cat.
Hmm, maybe I should call a doctor... or a vet for a check-up.
Aha, a declaration of war?
No, let's just quietly eat some stew for dinner.
Berry showed me some new tea party ideas she has.
She's always coming up with something.
And Chloe will reject every last one.
I agree that the tea party needs some freshening up.
So you're on Rims and Berry's side?
First, I suggest switching from serving hot tea to cold drinks.
And rather than cookies, why not some baked fish?
I think even Berry would reject that idea.
There's a rumor that Chloe has a large collection of forbidden books...
Would you know anything about that?
Nope. Not a whisper.
You do know something, don't you...!
I just said the exact opposite.
But you always know everything.
Even if I did know something, I wouldn't tell you.
The next time someone says I'm your "familiar", I'll punch you in the nose.
So make sure you explain to everyone that I'm not.
But you don't want me to refer to you as my "family" or "friend" either.
Just thinking about it makes me cringe.
How about "roommate"?
...Maybe more like "owner".
Who owns who?
Don't bother your owner with such questions.
By the way, Abigail still refers to me as a dog.
Do you have any idea how insulting that is?
You really hate dogs, huh?
They're such stupid creatures.
There must be a witch who has taken on a dog form somewhere.
I should introduce you someday.
Have you ever heard this riddle, Canele?
“What goes on four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, and three legs in the evening?”
I really can't work it out.
Where did you even hear it?
There was a book I picked up from Chloe's study a while back.
Apparently, it's a riddle witches often ask when testing mortals.
What kind of test is that? It's simple.
The answer has to be "Fiena".
Aha! Of course!
The cycle of life and decay must exist within purity.
No impurity should corrupt the essence... Maydel makes sure of that.
The seed has rotted away into black mud...
But Maydel believes new leaves can still grow.
The swamp is a land of death and decay...
Yet also a land of overflowing life.
Saving this life from corruption is the duty of a swamp witch.
However... Maydel also wishes to save her friend.
Do not fear, for Maydel is always keeping watch.
...Hehe... Hey there, little witch...
You're... ready, aren't you...?
What are you doing, Sil?
You haven't forgotten we promised to go to the Lapis Market together, have you...?
No... I remember.
I just started regretting it the second I saw your face.
Too late for regrets. You're coming with me.
Sigh. Guess I don't have a choice...
Berry says she's busy with something else...
By the way, that outfit... I don't think I've seen it before.
Oh, Sil...
Going to the Lapis Market in work clothes would be positively uncivilized.
A-And the witches there are trend-obsessed snobs...
I-If you make eye contact, they'll greet you and start asking about your taste.
And if you can't answer properly...
You'll be the joke of every social gathering later!
That's a lot of prejudice.
You'll know whether it's prejudice once you see for yourself...
Come out when you're ready, Sil.
Yeah, yeah.
I'm heading out. Watch the house for me.
W-What's going on...?
It's more crowded than I expected...
Crowded? It looks pretty empty to me.
Y-You talk to the merchants.
How shy can you possibly be?
Oh my, welcome, welcome~!
It has truly been so long~!
Rims, is she a witch you know?
N-No way...
Oh, is this our first meeting?
Well, no matter. It only means you're guests I am delighted to see!
What sort of item are you looking for? Jewels? Works of art?
How about this accessory? Its color would perfectly complement that deathly complexion of yours.
I-I'm not really...
Oh, is the price giving you pause?
For first-time customers, I can offer a special price...
H-Help me, Sil!
Sil...?
Ah, the one I've heard rumors about...
I'm Sil. This half-dead friend here is Rims.
My name is Bazira. I am the Coin Witch who leads this caravan.
If it concerns business, please tell me anything you need! Oh, if you require a business card...
Wait, wait. Don't get ahead of yourself.
We're here to get the ingredients we need for the next tea party.
A tea party?
Yes. We need the items written here.
Let's see...
Oh my, every last one is quite valuable.
Unfortunately, that is a problem. We cannot sell any goods at the moment.
What? Why?
Now, where should I begin explaining...?
First, would you look over there?
That is the entrance leading to the Jewel Witch's realm.
The Jewel Witch?
Don't you remember? The one who was incredibly picky at the tea party.
Was that so...?
That very Jewel Witch is currently missing.
Hmm, missing... For how long?
At least a few months, it would seem...
A-And... what does that have to do with not selling goods...?
We had been sourcing some materials through the Jewel Witch...
But since she disappeared, we have been unable to obtain those goods.
Because of that, our caravan is in quite a bind.
You might say our usual trade volume has dropped considerably.
So that's why the market is emptier than I heard it would be.
Exactly. It seems recovering our lost reputation will take some effort, doesn't it?
And to do that, our top priority is finding the Jewel Witch!
I see.
I-I see... I hope you find her.
Nothing we can do, so should we head back?
Yes. I don't want to stay any longer in a place with such harsh sunlight.
Please wait a moment, everyone.
Did you not come here for your tea party?
W-Well, yes, but...
We'll figure something out later.
Hehehe...
Very well. It seems I underestimated you all.
To think you would feign indifference even in such a crisis to secure better terms...
No, that's not it. We really were leaving...
Now! Please look at this!
Wow! What is all this?
If you find the Jewel Witch for us, all of this will be yours!
Really?
If that is still not enough... here! Please read this!
What is this document? Are all these tiny specks supposed to be letters?
If you locate the Jewel Witch!
Every benefit written here will be yours!
How is it? Not bad terms, right?
Sorry, I haven't even read three lines yet.
Fine, we'll do it.
Hey!
Excellent! Then we have a deal.
Hehehe... I will meet you at the entrance to the realm!
How could you accept that so easily?
Good grief, Sil...
This is all for the tea party, isn't it?
You don't mean that at all...
But if we're looking for a witch, we have you. We'll manage somehow.
Th-That's why I accepted...
So, what exactly is waiting in there?
There must be a reason you aren't searching yourself.
The Jewel Witch enjoys displaying her creations.
The problem is the guards protecting those valuables...
After losing their master, they began attacking visitors indiscriminately.
Our employees, who know little beyond counting coins, were not enough to handle them.
But for the Thread Witch, this should be no trouble at all. Rest assured!
This one... She must have planned to dump this on you from the start.
No wonder she kept staring at my face.
Fine. We just need to find the Jewel Witch, right?
Of course!
Cough, cough. Look at all this dust.
Without its witch, maybe the realm is starting to decay.
Leave it to me from here.
I heard she disappeared quite a while ago. Can you still do it?
Of course.
Sniff, sniff... Sniff, sniff...
How is it?
I can definitely smell the Jewel Witch.
Really? You're sure?
My nose never lies.
Besides, it's the scent of a witch I've met before... There's no mistake.
All right. Let's use that as our clue and search.
And if we can fulfill our contract with Bazira while we're at it, even better.
B-But... there's something bothering me...
What?
It's faint, but... I smell something strange...
A strange smell?
Is it connected to the Jewel Witch?
I-I'm not sure yet.
Something is spreading a suspicious smell through this realm...
Just hearing that doesn't tell me what it feels like.
Ugh... It's hard to explain...
Right, Sil. If I compare it to your scent...
Ugh, no thanks.
Huh?! What was that?
L-Looks like we're trapped...
Maybe it's built so you can't leave once you enter.
Hey! Is anyone out there?
Looks like they can't hear us.
Maybe they're pretending not to hear.
They definitely knew about this!
N-No wonder the contract terms were too good to be true.
You're the one who took the bait.
And thanks to that, we're trapped. What now?
So what if we can't get out?
We were planning to head deeper anyway, weren't we?
Could things possibly get any worse from here?
It got worse the second you said that.
Ah... A poison fog packed with curses...
The perfect choice for finishing off the living.
Phew... Good thing I'm dead.
That Bazira never said a word about something like this...!
Cough, cough...!
Ugh, we need to get out of here first!
